paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: : Linguistic and geographic trends over time in harmful language research. Notably, the number of datasets for the non-top five languages continues to be lower than all English ones, while since 2017 we see more and more datasets in languages other than English.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets related to harmful language research over time, categorized by language. The horizontal axis represents the year, ranging from 2012 to 2022, with tick labels displayed for each year. The vertical axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and is scaled on a logarithmic scale from 0 to 10^2. Six languages are represented by different colored bars: English (blue), All other (orange), Arabic (green), Bengali (red), Spanish (purple), and Russian (brown). For each year, there is a group of six bars, one for each language, arranged side-by-side allowing for observation of values across years. The shortest bar, representing the number of Arabic datasets in 2012, has an approximate value of 1, while the tallest bar for English datasets in 2022 has an approximate value of 100. The bars representing “All other” consistently have a value between 1 and 10 across all years, while English datasets show a general increase throughout the time series. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order other than by year. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or annotations.
